_comment: Wartości domyślne per szablon. Klucz = placeholder; 'subject' może używać [PLACEHOLDERÓW] z rekordu klienta. Rekord klienta (clients/<domena>.json) nadpisuje wszystko; jego sekcja templates.<szablon> nadpisuje rekord. Od 2026-09-24 wszystko po angielsku. Od 2026-09-28 bez domyślnych zdań o wyniku na listach AI (LIST RESULT, AI SOURCE, PLACE, AI RESULT) — każdy klient wpisuje je sam, a LISTED (yes/no) musi pasować do szablonu. Od 2026-10-01 szablony w design systemie appsynth.pl; HEADLINE = nagłówek H1 maila (może zawierać inne placeholdery), po nim w cold-mail stałe podświetlone «Yet.», w cold-mail-listed «For now.», w follow-up «Free.».

cold-mail.subject: We asked AI who it recommends for [SERVICE] in [CITY]. [COMPANY] wasn't on the list.
cold-mail.HEADLINE: AI recommends [TRADE] in [CITY]. Not [COMPANY].

cold-mail-listed.subject: We asked AI who it recommends for [SERVICE] in [CITY]. [COMPANY] came last.
cold-mail-listed.HEADLINE: AI names [COMPANY] — last.

follow-up.subject: Re: We asked AI who it recommends for [SERVICE] in [CITY]
follow-up.HEADLINE: Your AI visibility report is ready.

offer.subject: Report and offer: AI visibility for [COMPANY]
offer.TABLE_TITLE: What we offer · prices excl. VAT
offer.HEADLINE: Report and offer for [company.no].
